STARRED REVIEW
October 05, 2026

Green City Wars

  • By Adrian Tchaikovsky, narrated by John Pirhalla
Review by Toby Rose
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:53
Instaread
John Pirhalla is the perfect fit to narrate the audiobook of Adrian Tchaikovsky’s sci-fi noir Green City Wars, bringing out the story’s grit and humor.
Share this Article:

Adrian Tchaikovsky’s sci-fi noir, Green City Wars (13 hours), is about genetically engineered animals living in the underground world of a solar-powered human city. Skotch, a raccoon, is a private investigator who’s tasked with finding a missing mouse scientist, leading him to uncover a deep-seated conspiracy involving animal welfare and corporate greed. Once it ramps up, the novel becomes a complex social commentary on class divisions.

John Pirhalla is the perfect fit as narrator, leaning into the noir tone and bringing out the story’s grit and humor. He makes Skotch appropriately skeptical, and his vocal versatility especially stands out when voicing side characters. LuLu the well-fed pigeon is a highlight of the audiobook, with her cheery busybody cadence, while the gangster rats are characterized with low, menacing voices. Pirhalla makes every animal Skotch meets along the way feel animated, but these animals are decidedly not Disney.

Read our starred review of the print version of Green City Wars.
